sections.title: Sounds of ar
paragraphs: The letters ar name their sound as /ɑːr/. Their main sound is heard in (arm) /ɑːm/, which is a body part between your shoulder and hand. These letters make four sounds in English words.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: For the first sound, drop your jaw wide and pull your tongue low and back. Next, keep that open shape and curl your tongue tip back slightly. For the third sound, keep your mouth relaxed in the centre with a soft, weak murmur. For the fourth sound, pull your tongue back and make your lips into a small circle. Put a hand on your throat to feel it vibrate.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: In a stressed syllable before a consonant or at the end of a word, ar makes a long open sound as in (car) /kɑː/. Before a vowel, ar adds a smooth curl of the tongue as in (starry) /stɑː.ri/. In an unstressed syllable, ar becomes a weak murmur as in (sugar) /ʃʊɡ.ə/. After the letter w, ar makes a deep sound with lips in a circle as in (war) /wɔː/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not shorten this sound to the quick vowel in cat. Drop your jaw fully and hold the sound longer, like the voice you make when the doctor looks inside your mouth. In words like war, do not keep your lips wide. Make your lips form a small circle instead.
